title: The Wildman of Whitehall
full_text_transcript: Local party reports encounter near the cliffs along Lake Champlain. Witnesses observed a seven-foot tall creature covered in dark fur bounding up a steep ravine after being surprised near a creek bed.

title: Strange Tracks Found in the Timber
full_text_transcript: Hunters near the Cuyahoga River valley discovered a series of massive human-like footprints measuring over sixteen inches in length, deeply impressed into frozen mud.

title: Border Monster Terrifies Settlers
full_text_transcript: Farmers along the Red River valley report repeated nighttime disturbances involving powerful wood knocking, heavy footsteps outside homesteads, and unexplainable guttural cries.

title: Mountain Beast Seen by Loggers
full_text_transcript: Logging crew in the foothills of Mount Rainier reports observing a massive, ape-like figure watching their camp from a timbered ridge before vanishing into dense brush without a sound.
